title: Operational Narrative & Confidence Brief — Monthly Roadmap Spotlight
creator: Avery Chen
description: Purpose: Produce a concise, decision-oriented package for the monthly executive roadmap spotlight that synthesizes current initiative confidence, outstanding risks, and explicit decision asks. Deliverables: (1) 1-page executive summary (pre-read), (2) 10-12 slide narrative deck for the monthly ops/exec meeting, (3) initiative-level risk heatmap with mitigations and owners, (4) decision slate with recommended options and tradeoffs, (5) updated OKR roll-up and impact estimates. Scope: Focus on initiatives that are live or have committed customer impact in the next 90 days (runtime performance, Dedicated autoscaling controls, Private deploy cadence, Console rollout). Excludes deep technical postmortems (those are separate incidents). Stakeholders: PM leads for runtime, dedicated, private; Eng leads for serving runtime and infra; Design for customer-facing communications; GTM and Finance for cost/commitment framing; Customer Success for any high-touch customers. Timeline: draft deck by 2026-03-12, internal review by 2026-03-15, pre-reads distributed 72 hours before meeting, final deck by 2026-03-19. Decision asks: confirm rollout window for runtime-1.18, approve additional burst capacity for Dedicated pilot, accept proposed Q2 reallocation of two engineering squads. Success criteria: clarity on decisions, explicit owners for mitigation actions, and no-blocker signoff from Eng on latency SLO remediation plans.
acceptance_criteria: 10-12 slide deck reviewed and approved by Eng and Design
Risk heatmap created with mitigations and named owners for each high/medium risk
Decision slate with recommended option, trade-offs, and acceptance criteria
Pre-read distributed to exec list 72 hours before meeting and uploaded to Confluence/Drive
